name: Bloomroom
original_description: Bloomroom is a creative floral design tool for making editable digital 3D arrangements. Explore flower combinations, color palettes and compositions for personal expression or a digital gift. Choose flowers, colors, quantities, containers and scenes from the actual Bloomroom catalog, validate the design, then compile an editable 3D work. Anonymous design needs no Bloomroom account. Editing requires the creation credential; a public viewing link cannot recover it. Temporary draft links expire after 24 hours; sign in on the website to save to an account. Preview SVGs are composition schematics; the studio renders the actual 3D work. Physical delivery, payments, messaging and Bloomroom paid AI generation are not provided.
